usage: The word '健康' (gin6 hong1) can be used as a noun to refer to the state of being healthy.
'健康' can also be used as an adjective to describe someone or something that is healthy.
When used as an adjective, '健康' usually appears before the noun it describes.
You can combine '健康' with verbs like '保持' (to keep) or '促進' (to promote) to talk about maintaining or improving health.
In questions, '健康' often appears as part of phrases like '你健康嗎？' (Are you healthy?).
